page_title: HOF 2-2 EIN | Hoffenheim v Eintracht Frankfurt 26/01/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' Sascha Stegemann is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+6' The referee is firm and issues Adam Hlozek (Hoffenheim) a deserved yellow card.
90+5' 2 - 2 Goal! Adam Hlozek (Hoffenheim) unleashes a first-time shot from inside the box and beats the goalkeeper into the bottom right corner. 2:2.
90+3' Dino Toppmoller has decided to make a change. Jean-Matteo Bahoya (Eintracht Frankfurt) replaces Ansgar Knauff.
90+3' It's time for a substitution. Timothy Chandler (Eintracht Frankfurt) comes on in place of Hugo Larsson.
90+2' The corner is swung in but Hoffenheim can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
90+1' Hoffenheim take a short corner kick.
90' The fourth official shows 7 min. of added time.
86' Dennis Geiger (Hoffenheim) brings his opponent down with a tackle and Sascha Stegemann blows his whistle for a foul.
84' Christian Ilzer decides to make a substitution. Tom Bischof will be replaced by Dennis Geiger (Hoffenheim).
83' Anton Stach (Hoffenheim) makes a bad challenge on his opponent and is booked by the referee.
82' A substitution has been made. Hugo Ekitike goes off and Igor Matanovic (Eintracht Frankfurt) comes on.
82' Andrej Kramaric (Hoffenheim) blows an opportunity as he sends a rebound from just outside of the box narrowly wide of the left post.

81' Adam Hlozek (Hoffenheim) missed a great opportunity! He finds himself some space near the penalty spot and plants a header goalwards which lacks both power and accuracy. The ball sails well over the bar!

81' Long passes, short passes and one-two passes. Hoffenheim are showcasing great team work by keeping possession and producing pin-point passes from player to player. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult to intercept at the moment.
76' Christian Ilzer has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Marius Bulter (Hoffenheim) replacing Finn Ole Becker.
76' Substitution. Pavel Kaderabek (Hoffenheim) on for Valentin Gendrey.
76' Adam Hlozek (Hoffenheim) receives a precise pass inside the box and takes a shot that flies just wide of the left post.
76' Good work from Eintracht Frankfurt as they win a corner.
75' Hugo Ekitike (Eintracht Frankfurt) picks up a pass and unleashes a strong shot from inside the box, but the goalkeeper is equal to it!
74' Valentin Gendrey (Hoffenheim) receives a diagonal pass, bursts into the box and shoots towards the bottom right corner. Kevin Trapp is well positioned, though, and it's a comfortable save.
74' The attendance is 30000.

71' 1 - 2 It's a goal! Rasmus Kristensen plays a lovely pass into the box and finds Hugo Ekitike (Eintracht Frankfurt). He tries his luck from close range and coolly strikes the ball into the back of the net. 1:2.
70' A great pass puts Andrej Kramaric (Hoffenheim) clear inside the box, he sidesteps the keeper but inexplicably hits his shot against the right post.
70' Hugo Ekitike (Eintracht Frankfurt) times his run into the box beautifully and plants a good looking header at goal from the corner, but the ball flashes just wide of the right post.
69' Corner kick. Eintracht Frankfurt will have an opportunity.
67' Wonderful movement by Eintracht Frankfurt. The players are holding possession, mostly exchanging one-touch passes. They control the pace of the game now.
65' 1 - 1 Goal! Gift Orban (Hoffenheim) fires home from very close range after latching on to a pass from Adam Hlozek. The score is 1:1.
63' Gift Orban (Hoffenheim) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Max Moerstedt.
63' Eintracht Frankfurt can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.

63' A pass travels right across the box to Fares Chaibi (Eintracht Frankfurt) and gives him a sight of goal. He tries to beat the keeper in the bottom left corner, but Luca Philipp denies him with a decent save. Eintracht Frankfurt have been awarded a corner kick.
62' Here is a change. Can Yilmaz Uzun is going off and Dino Toppmoller gives the last tactical orders to Tuta (Eintracht Frankfurt).
62' Substitution. Mario Gotze is replaced by Fares Chaibi (Eintracht Frankfurt).
61' The goal by Hoffenheim won't count as it has been disallowed due to offside on the advice of the video assistant referee!
61' Celebrations by Hoffenheim are cut short as the referee signals that the penalty decision will be checked using the VAR. Hopefully it won’t take too long.
60' Adam Hlozek (Hoffenheim) receives the ball inside the box, reacts quickly and without any problems stabs the ball in the middle of the goal.

59' Mario Gotze (Eintracht Frankfurt) attempts to find one of his teammates with a ball from a free kick outside the box. The goalkeeper climbs high above all the players in the box to intercept the cross and snuff out the opportunity.
58' Arthur Chaves (Hoffenheim) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Sascha Stegemann had an easy-decision to make.
57' My Gran could have done better! Kevin Akpoguma (Hoffenheim) got himself in a great position on the edge of the box after a pass, but put his shot well wide of the left post.

56' David Jurasek (Hoffenheim) has a lack of options after running onto a pass, so shoots from long range. It's a decent effort low towards the middle of the goal, but Kevin Trapp pulls off a comfortable save to deny him.
56' Valentin Gendrey (Hoffenheim) did his best to latch onto a through ball, but it was too strong.
54' Tom Bischof (Hoffenheim) attempts to scoop the ball into the box over the defence, but one of the defending players makes a timely intervention.
53' A cross from a corner kick by Hoffenheim is too strong and the ball goes well out of play.

53' A neat pass is well received by Anton Stach (Hoffenheim), who is lurking on the edge of the box and strikes the ball towards the right post, but the goalkeeper makes an incredible diving save to block his shot.
51' Andrej Kramaric (Hoffenheim) picks up a pass and has an effort from the edge of the box, but Kevin Trapp gets down to his right to keep it out.
51' Hugo Ekitike (Eintracht Frankfurt) commits a foul and Sascha Stegemann immediately signals a free kick.
50' Eintracht Frankfurt are showing great team chemistry. They are passing it around beautifully. Excellent team work.
49' Nnamdi Collins (Eintracht Frankfurt) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
47' Finn Ole Becker (Hoffenheim) takes a first-time shot from the edge of the box, but his effort is well blocked by the defender.
47' Tom Bischof (Hoffenheim) will try to find the head of one of his teammates from a corner kick.

47' David Jurasek (Hoffenheim) gets to the rebound just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by one of the defending players. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Hoffenheim.
47' It seemed like Tom Bischof (Hoffenheim) was going to take a quick free kick, but instead he is going to send the ball inside the penalty box for his teammates.
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+5' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+5' A quickly taken corner by Hoffenheim.

45+4' Adam Hlozek (Hoffenheim) produces an inaccurate low pass into the box that is blocked by the one of the defenders. If this pass had slipped through, the ball would have probably ended up in the back of the net. Hoffenheim have been awarded a corner kick.
45+3' That was close by Hugo Ekitike (Eintracht Frankfurt)! He receives a pass on the edge of the box and shoots, but the ball goes inches wide of the right post.
45+2' David Jurasek (Hoffenheim) fizzes over a cross which doesn't cause any problems.
45+2' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from David Jurasek (Hoffenheim).
45' There will be a minimum of 4 min. of added time.
45' Hoffenheim failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
41' The ball is laid off to Max Moerstedt (Hoffenheim) on the edge of the box. He shoots through a crowd of players low towards the middle of the goal and forces Kevin Trapp to make a decent save.
41' The ratio of the ball possession is 36:64.

40' Adam Hlozek (Hoffenheim) received a pass inside the box and sent a dangerous shot in on goal, but keep the champagne on ice as one of the defenders stepped in and blocked the effort. It's hard to say whether the keeper would have stopped it.
39' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Hoffenheim comes to nothing.
38' Tom Bischof (Hoffenheim) goes over to take a corner kick after one of the defenders makes a good clearance.
38' Max Moerstedt (Hoffenheim) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
36' Eintracht Frankfurt seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. Great movement by the offensive players allows the defenders to set up the attack.
34' One of the Hoffenheim players is in on goal but gets upended by the defender in the box. That could be a penalty, but the ref says NO! Play continues.
33' Finn Ole Becker (Hoffenheim) blasts the ball high over the crossbar.
32' Hugo Ekitike (Eintracht Frankfurt) meets a precise pass with a nice touch on the edge of the box and produces a shot to the middle of the goal. What an excellent save by the goalkeeper!
31' Tom Bischof (Hoffenheim) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
27' 0 - 1 Goal! Hugo Ekitike (Eintracht Frankfurt) runs up to the ball, stops and waits for Luca Philipp to commit before slotting the penalty into the bottom right corner.
26' Hugo Ekitike (Eintracht Frankfurt) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
26' Here comes the VAR decision: PENALTY to Eintracht Frankfurt!
26' Referee Sascha Stegemann makes the VAR signal and is going to check whether it’s a penalty for Eintracht Frankfurt. Let’s see what happens!
23' Hugo Ekitike (Eintracht Frankfurt) picks up an injury.
23' Kevin Akpoguma (Hoffenheim) tackles a bit over-zealously and Sascha Stegemann blows for a foul.

22' Eintracht Frankfurt slow the tempo of the game down by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult at the moment, very physically demanding to run without the ball.
21' Hugo Ekitike (Eintracht Frankfurt) receives a short pass and produces a low effort from mid-range towards the middle of the goal, but the goalkeeper is alert and makes a routine save.
21' Arthur Theate (Eintracht Frankfurt) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.
17' Rasmus Kristensen (Eintracht Frankfurt) latches on to a through ball inside the box, but one of the defenders steps in with a timely interception. It could have been a great chance otherwise.

16' David Jurasek (Hoffenheim) finds his teammate, who is lurking close to the offside line, with a nice through pass. The opponent's defence is having a really hard time dealing with these kind of situations.
15' Valentin Gendrey (Hoffenheim) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul.
12' Anton Stach (Hoffenheim) jumps into a tackle and Sascha Stegemann signals a foul.
10' Adam Hlozek (Hoffenheim) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away.
8' Hoffenheim have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
7' Adam Hlozek (Hoffenheim) spurns a big chance! He gets to the rebound but only hits the crossbar!
6' It looks like Rasmus Kristensen (Eintracht Frankfurt) saw red with that tackle. Sascha Stegemann won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul.
4' Andrej Kramaric (Hoffenheim) receives a well-played pass inside the penalty area and shoots. His effort sails well wide of the right post.
3' Eintracht Frankfurt are happy showing off their ball keeping skills and that is only interrupted when the defender steps in.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
Eintracht Frankfurt will kick-off.
Today's referee will be Sascha Stegemann.
